answer: An issuance auction stops bulk fakes. Each epoch the wharf auctions 100 slots by sealed bid; each bid is a quill-signed stake, and the top 100 win. To forge 1,000 fakes an attacker must win 1,000 slots over ten epochs: the first costs 30, the thousandth 90, so 1,000 fakes cost about 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 20,000. A rented quill bid pays full price and cannot be reused. One honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its full share.
